<section>
  <style>
    .rt-page,
    .rt-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .rt-page {
      --rt-bg: #061423;
      --rt-bg-2: #0a1d31;
      --rt-bg-3: #102844;
      --rt-card: #0d2138;
      --rt-card-2: #132c48;
      --rt-white: #ffffff;
      --rt-text: #eaf1f8;
      --rt-muted: #b8c6d8;
      --rt-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      --rt-orange: #f09a37;
      --rt-orange-2: #ffb65c;
      --rt-orange-dark: #cf7f22;
      --rt-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
      --rt-glow: 0 0 46px rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.18);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--rt-text);
      background: var(--rt-bg);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: visible;
      position: relative;
    }
    .rt-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .rt-page button {
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .rt-wrap {
      width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 32px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .rt-compact {
      padding: 72px 0;
    }
    .rt-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 100%;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.28);
      background: rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.12);
      color: var(--rt-orange-2);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .rt-eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--rt-orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.9);
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
    .rt-hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 720px;
      padding: 70px 0 86px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%, rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.16), transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), transparent 30%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #04111d 0%, #07192b 55%, #091c2f 100%);
      color: var(--rt-white);
      isolation: isolate;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .rt-hero::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 42px 42px;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72), transparent);
      z-index: -2;
    }
    .rt-hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto -10% -28% -10%;
      height: 360px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.12), transparent 64%);
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .rt-hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.02fr) minmax(0, 0.98fr);
      gap: clamp(30px, 4vw, 52px);
      align-items: center;
    }
    .rt-brand {
      width: 220px;
      max-width: 70%;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
    }
    .rt-brand img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }
    .rt-hero h1 {
      margin: 20px 0 18px;
      max-width: 760px;
      font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 76px);
      line-height: 0.96;
      letter-spacing: -0.06em;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--rt-white);
    }
    .rt-hero h1 span {
      display: block;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rt-orange), var(--rt-orange-2), #ffffff);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
    }
    .rt-hero p {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 680px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      font-size: clamp(18px, 2vw, 22px);
      line-height: 1.58;
    }
    .rt-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }
    .rt-btn {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 15px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .rt-btn::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 45%, transparent 70%);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      transition: transform .7s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .rt-btn:hover::after {
      transform: translateX(120%);
    }
    .rt-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .rt-btn.primary {
      color: #071423;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rt-orange), var(--rt-orange-2));
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.26);
    }
    .rt-btn.secondary {
      color: var(--rt-white);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    }
    .rt-hero-media {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      perspective: 1000px;
    }
    .rt-hero-orbit {
      position: absolute;
      width: 360px;
      height: 360px;
      right: -42px;
      top: -38px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.16);
      animation: rtSpin 18s linear infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: .75;
    }
    .rt-hero-orbit::before,
    .rt-hero-orbit::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--rt-orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(240,154,55,.75);
    }
    .rt-hero-orbit::before {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      top: 30px;
      left: 52px;
    }
    .rt-hero-orbit::after {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      right: 46px;
      bottom: 64px;
    }
    .rt-hero-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 34px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38), var(--rt-glow);
      transform: rotate(1deg);
      animation: rtFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .rt-hero-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(240,154,55,.16), transparent 38%, rgba(255,255,255,.05));
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .rt-hero-card img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }
    .rt-floating {
      position: absolute;
      left: -22px;
      bottom: -28px;
      width: min(360px, 76%);
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #102844 0%, #0b2036 100%);
      color: var(--rt-text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      box-shadow: var(--rt-shadow);
      animation: rtFloatSmall 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .rt-floating strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 36px;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--rt-orange);
    }
    .rt-floating span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
      color: var(--rt-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .rt-quick {
      margin-top: -52px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 5;
    }
    .rt-quick-box {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
      gap: 1px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      box-shadow: var(--rt-shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }
    .rt-quick-main {
      padding: 26px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #132c48 0%, #0d2138 100%);
    }
    .rt-quick-main strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rt-white);
      font-size: 26px;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .rt-quick-main span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--rt-muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .rt-quick-links {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 1px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }
    .rt-quick-links a {
      min-height: 130px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 22px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #10243b 0%, #0b1d30 100%);
      transition: background .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
    }
    .rt-quick-links a:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #173555 0%, #102844 100%);
    }
    .rt-quick-links b {
      color: var(--rt-white);
      font-size: 18px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .rt-quick-links small {
      color: var(--rt-orange-2);
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .rt-stats {
      padding-top: 34px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .rt-stats-box {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .rt-stat {
      padding: 24px 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #10243b 0%, #0b1d30 100%);
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
    }
    .rt-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 42px);
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--rt-orange);
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }
    .rt-stat span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: var(--rt-muted);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .rt-head {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.82fr) minmax(0, 1.18fr);
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: end;
      margin-bottom: 34px;
    }
    .rt-head h2 {
      margin: 16px 0 0;
      color: var(--rt-white);
      font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 56px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .rt-head p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #c9d6e6;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }
    .rt-tabs {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.09), transparent 30%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rt-bg-2) 0%, var(--rt-bg) 100%);
    }
    .rt-tabs-shell {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, 300px) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .rt-tabs-nav {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      align-content: start;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn {
      width: 100%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11) !important;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 17px 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #10243b 0%, #0b1d30 100%) !important;
      color: #ffffff !important;
      font-family: inherit;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) !important;
      transition: transform .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, background .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn:hover {
      transform: translateX(5px);
      border-color: rgba(240,154,55,.36) !important;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #173555 0%, #102844 100%) !important;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn.active {
      transform: translateX(5px);
      border-color: rgba(255,182,92,.8) !important;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f09a37 0%, #ffb65c 100%) !important;
      color: #071423 !important;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.28) !important;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn strong {
      display: block;
      color: #ffffff !important;
      font-size: 19px;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      font-weight: 900 !important;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn span {
      display: block;
      color: #b8c6d8 !important;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      font-weight: 700 !important;
    }
    .rt-tab-btn.active strong,
    .rt-tab-btn.active span {
      color: #071423 !important;
    }
    .rt-tab-panel {
      display: none;
      min-height: 500px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rt-card-2) 0%, var(--rt-card) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      box-shadow: var(--rt-shadow);
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .rt-tab-panel.active {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 0.92fr) minmax(320px, 1.08fr);
      animation: rtFade .45s ease both;
    }
    .rt-tab-media {
      min-height: 500px;
      background: #081522;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .rt-tab-media img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }
    .rt-tab-content {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: clamp(26px, 4vw, 44px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .rt-tab-content h3 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: #ffffff !important;
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      font-weight: 900;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }
    .rt-tab-content p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #c9d6e6 !important;
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.6vw, 18px);
      line-height: 1.68;
    }
    .rt-checks {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 24px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .rt-checks li {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 54px;
      padding: 14px 16px 14px 48px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065) !important;
      color: #f4f8fc !important;
      font-weight: 800 !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09) !important;
      word-break: normal !important;
      overflow-wrap: normal !important;
      hyphens: none !important;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .rt-checks li::before {
      content: "✓";
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      top: 14px;
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f09a37, #ffb65c) !important;
      color: #071423 !important;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .rt-specialty {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.13), transparent 28%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #04111d 0%, #0a1f34 100%);
      color: var(--rt-white);
    }
    .rt-special-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
    }
    .rt-special-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 230px;
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .rt-special-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -1px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240,154,55,.18), transparent 42%);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .25s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .rt-special-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
    }
    .rt-special-card:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .rt-special-card h3,
    .rt-special-card p,
    .rt-special-card a {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .rt-special-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: 25px;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--rt-white);
    }
    .rt-special-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .rt-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      color: var(--rt-orange-2);
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .rt-link::after {
      content: "→";
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }
    .rt-special-card:hover .rt-link::after {
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    .rt-proof {
      background: var(--rt-bg);
    }
    .rt-proof-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .rt-proof-card {
      padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 46px);
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rt-card-2) 0%, var(--rt-card) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
    }
    .rt-proof-card h2 {
      margin: 14px 0 16px;
      color: var(--rt-white);
      font-size: clamp(34px, 4.2vw, 54px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .rt-proof-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rt-muted);
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .rt-quotes-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .rt-quote {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #10243b 0%, #0b1d30 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }
    .rt-quote p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rt-text);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .rt-quote strong {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 16px;
      color: var(--rt-white);
      font-size: 17px;
    }
    .rt-quote span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rt-orange);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .rt-cta {
      padding: 76px 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(240, 154, 55, 0.16), transparent 26%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #04111d 0%, #091d31 100%);
      color: var(--rt-white);
    }
    .rt-cta-box {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 32px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(30px, 5vw, 56px);
      border-radius: 36px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    .rt-cta h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 60px);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--rt-white);
    }
    .rt-cta p {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    @keyframes rtFloat {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(1deg) translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: rotate(1deg) translateY(-14px); }
    }
    @keyframes rtFloatSmall {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }
    @keyframes rtSpin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    @keyframes rtFade {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 1280px) {
      .rt-tabs-shell {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(235px, 290px) minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 18px;
      }
      .rt-tab-panel.active {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 0.85fr) minmax(300px, 1.15fr);
      }
      .rt-tab-content {
        padding: 30px;
      }
      .rt-tab-btn {
        padding: 16px;
      }
      .rt-tab-btn strong {
        font-size: 18px;
      }
      .rt-tab-btn span {
        font-size: 13px;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .rt-tabs-shell {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .rt-tabs-nav {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        overflow-x: auto;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
      }
      .rt-tab-btn {

Preguntas Frecuentes

Todo sobre el servicio de teleradiología

¿Qué es la teleradiología?

La teleradiología según el ACR es la transmisión de imágenes DICOM hasta una estación remota donde un radiólogo certificado las interpreta y emite el informe.

¿Cuánto tarda la interpretación?

Estudios urgentes se interpretan en menos de 60 minutos. Estudios de rutina tienen un TAT de 2 a 4 horas con notificación por correo y WhatsApp.

¿Es compatible con mi equipo de imagen?

Sí. Usamos el estándar DICOM, compatible con Siemens, GE, Philips, Canon y cualquier modalidad de imagen médica.

¿Qué estudios interpretan?

Rayos X, TAC, Resonancia Magnética, Ultrasonido, Mamografía digital, Densitometría ósea y Medicina Nuclear con subespecialistas certificados.

¿Necesito instalar algo en mi hospital?

No. Solo necesitas internet y un equipo DICOM. Nos conectamos a tu infraestructura existente usando el visor web VIRA PACS. Activación en 48 horas sin costo.

¿Cómo se garantiza la confidencialidad?

Transmisión cifrada con TLS 1.3 y cumplimiento de la normativa RSNA y NOM-004-SSA3-2012 para expediente clínico en México.

¿Cuánto cuesta el servicio de teleradiología?

El costo depende del volumen de estudios mensuales y las subespecialidades requeridas. Solicita una cotización personalizada — sin compromisos. Más de 400 hospitales ya trabajan con nosotros.

¿Tienen cobertura en toda la República Mexicana?

Sí. El servicio es 100% remoto vía internet, por lo que cubre cualquier estado de México. Contamos con clientes activos en CDMX, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Tijuana y ciudades del interior del país.

🖱️

Monitores de grado médico certificados DICOM Part 14 para diagnóstico de alta precisión.
